title: Claude Opus 5.5 / xhigh effort
description: A white pelican with a large peach throat pouch, orange-tipped beak, and black wing tips, its wings reaching to the handlebar and yellow legs on the pedals, riding a teal bicycle with black tires and silver spokes along a gray road with yellow center dashes through wavy green fields under hazy hills; a striped, comb-like patch shows in the road shadow.

generationHarness.notes: Fresh non-interactive invocation with a minimal replacement system prompt and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1; no tools, skills, hooks, MCP servers, CLAUDE.md, or memory in context. This CLI version also injects an environment block (cwd, OS, git status) and the account email, which cannot be disabled (~674-token bare context probe vs 253 on 2.1.214).

generationUsage.notes: Claude subscription invocation; total_cost_usd is the CLI's pricing estimate, not a separate API charge. The first attempt reached the CLI's 128000 output-token limit before returning any text; Claude Code retried automatically and the second attempt is the preserved response. Usage and cost cover both attempts.

unmetRequirements.evidence: Cast shadows break into sawtooth, stair-stepped edges on the grass in level-02, level-03, level-05, level-06, raised-01 and raised-02 (clearest in level-05), and striped comb-like patches appear in the road shadow near the wheels in initial, level-00, level-04 and raised-00. shadow() (line 120) limits the march to 40 steps inside the scene bounding box, with a minimum step of 0.006, so long grazing shadow rays stop before resolving.
